title: Write a Custom S3 Policy
description: Create a JSON policy that grants read‑only access to a single S3 bucket.
problemStatement: Write an IAM policy (in JSON) that allows a user to list the contents of an S3 bucket named `company-data-logs` and to download (GetObject) any object in that bucket. The user must not be allowed to delete or upload objects. Provide the full JSON.
hints: Remember to set Effect to Allow.
